metadata.description: Local administrator user for all VMs.
Local administrator password. Supply it at deployment time or through a secure parameter file.
Azure Bastion subnet address space. Must be at least /26 and named AzureBastionSubnet.
Low-cost VM size. Confirm regional availability before deployment.
SQL Server TCP port exposed inside the private subnet.
AdventureWorks backup URL used by the SQL 2019 post-deployment script.
Optional URL for a separately hosted gateway installer. Leave empty to install no gateway automatically.

parameters.runCommandParameters: [if(parameters('installDatabase'), createObject('value', createArray(createObject('name', 'BackupUrl', 'value', parameters('backupUrl')), createObject('name', 'SqlPort', 'value', string(parameters('sqlPort'))))), createObject('value', createArray()))]

[if(parameters('installDatabase'), createObject('value', createArray(createObject('name', 'BackupUrl', 'value', parameters('backupUrl')), createObject('name', 'SqlPort', 'value', string(parameters('sqlPort'))))), createObject('value', createArray()))]

parameters.extensionCommand: [if(not(empty(parameters('gatewayInstallerUrl'))), createObject('value', format('powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install-data-gateway.ps1 -InstallerUrl "{0}"', parameters('gatewayInstallerUrl'))), createObject('value', ''))]
